question: Which of the five has been most explicit about serving mass-affluent clients, and what exactly have they said?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James offers fee-based accounts within its PCG segment that comprise a wide array of products and programs, the majority invested in programs where financial advisors provide investment advisory services on a discretionary or non-discretionary basis.
items.quote: Fee-based accounts within our PCG segment are comprised of a wide array of products and programs that we offer our clients. The majority of assets in fee-based accounts within our PCG segment are invested in programs for which our financial advisors provide investment advisory services, either on a discretionary or non-discretionary basis.

items.text: Raymond James offers fee-based accounts invested in 'Managed programs' overseen by AMS (part of its Asset Management segment).
items.quote: We also offer our clients fee-based accounts that are invested in “Managed programs” overseen by AMS, which is part of our Asset Management segment.

items.text: Raymond James offers its Enhanced Savings Program (ESP), a deposit offering in which clients deposit cash in a high-yield Raymond James Bank account, with FDIC coverage of up to $50 million for certain accounts.
items.quote: These products include our ESP, where such deposits are held by Raymond James Bank, offer enhanced rates, and offer FDIC coverage of up to $50 million for certain accounts
items.definition: Our Enhanced Savings Program is a deposit offering in which clients, substantially all within our Private Client Group, deposit cash in a high-yield Raymond James Bank account.

items.text: Raymond James offers the RJBDP, a multi-bank sweep program where clients' cash deposits in brokerage accounts are swept into interest-bearing deposit accounts at its Bank segment and various third-party banks.
items.quote: We earn fees from the RJBDP, a multi-bank sweep program in which clients' cash deposits in their brokerage accounts are swept into interest-bearing deposit accounts at our Bank segment, as well as various third-party banks.

items.text: Raymond James launched Private Wealth Guided Portfolios, a risk-based model portfolio framework combining equity and fixed income allocations with an alternatives sleeve covering private markets and hedged strategies, for high-net-worth clients.
items.quote: this week, the firm announced the launch of Private Wealth Guided Portfolios, a risk-based model framework that combines equity and fixed income allocations with a dedicated alternatives sleeve covering private markets and hedged strategies.

items.text: Raymond James offers the Private Wealth Advisor Program/designation, providing training, coaching, and a peer network for advisors serving high-net-worth clients (generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets).
items.quote: the firm's Raymond James Private Wealth Advisor designation program, launched in September 2022, which provides training, coaching, and a peer network for advisors who specialize in high-net-worth clients - generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets.
items.definition: high-net-worth clients - generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets

items.text: Raymond James offers a private investments desk for clients with $50 million and above of investable assets, plus an open architecture alternatives platform spanning private equity mutual fund-type products and private placements.
items.quote: we have a private investments desk, what we call it, private investments for clients with $50 million and above of investable assets and everything in between.

items.text: Raymond James launched a SIMPLE IRA Employer Advisory and Consulting Services (SIACS) Program for small businesses with up to 100 employees, in partnership with Capital Group American Funds.
items.quote: The firm has partnered with Capital Group American Funds for the program, which is designed for small businesses with up to 100 employees and combines an IRA with 401(k) plan features

items.text: Raymond James offers an open architecture platform and 'a wide range of products', including private wealth solutions and a suite of proprietary active exchange-traded funds launched in October 2025.
items.quote: The firm also launched a suite of proprietary active exchange-traded funds in October 2025

items.text: Raymond James offers a 'broad range of third-party and proprietary investment products and services' through its PCG segment and, through RCS, custodial services, trade execution, and research to third-party RIAs.
items.quote: We offer a broad range of third-party and proprietary investment products and services to meet our clients’ various investment and financial needs.

cells.reason: The passages describe the products, services, platforms and fee levels Raymond James offers to clients (including wealthy/affluent clients), but none explicitly distinguishes 'mass-affluent' clients as a named segment; offerings are for clients generally or for high-net-worth clients.
